findings.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
findings.review_comment: The entries_between method constructs SQL queries by directly interpolating user-controlled timestamp parameters into the query string, creating a SQL injection vulnerability. While float() conversion validates numeric input, it doesn't prevent SQL injection attacks. Replace the string interpolation with parameterized queries using sql.run_query's 'values' parameter to safely bind the earliest and latest timestamps.
